{{Quote|There you go again—great: the Satellite. It means a lot of fairly nasty things, things that you find under rocks.|Lando Calrissian|<ref name="Lando">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Mindharp of Sharu]]''</ref>}}
'''The Satellite''' was a [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] card exclusive to the [[Centran sabacc/Legends|Centran]] variant of the game. As a face card, it only appeared once in the deck. In addition to being played, the card carried meaning in cartomancy. When drawn for the position representing what will happen to the subject and how they will react, The Satellite implied that the subject would face deception, deceit, or betrayal.<ref name="Lando" /> 

==Appearances==
*''[[Lando Calrissian and the Mindharp of Sharu]]'' {{1st}}
